messages:
Maya: Quick sync 1 1 I'm finishing the cloud marketplace refkit ops runbook. Need infra + partner enablement to review today. Essentials: doc, minimal Terraform examples, and smoke tests.
Oliver: Which parts need infra vs enablement sign-off?
Maya: Infra: autoscale examples, IAM snippets, cost guidance. Enablement: onboarding steps, artifact layout, packaging checklist.
Sarah: I'll draft onboarding steps and the partner checklist. Drop the doc link?
Maya: https://redwood.internal/docs/refkit/ops-runbook-draft (view-only). TODOs: add quickstart TF snippet for single-region, clarify KMS best-practices, add canary rollback notes.
Devon: Infra here. Will add spot+reserved example for cost-sensitive partners and a smoke harness.
Oliver: I'll add autoscale policy + example snippet (example to land in doc):
```
resource "redwood_inference_pool" "partner_default" {
  region = "us-west-2"
  gpu_type = "a100"
  min_instances = 1
  max_instances = 8
  spot_percentage = 60
}
```
Alex: Packaging heads-up: image tags must be immutable for marketplace. Partners must pin tags and provide a manifest.json for Verified Models section.
Maya: Noted. Sarah: include in checklist: account setup, KMS key creation, VPC/network checklist, smoke test commands.
Sarah: Done. Example smoke test: `curl -X POST https://<endpoint>/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'`
Devon: Add SLO guidance (p50/p95 targets) and fallback variant note. I'll draft numbers.
Maya: Also need a rollback playbook: traffic flip to hosted fallback, revoke keys, contact list.
Oliver: I'll add cost-estimate guidance (GPU hourly range + batching recommendations).
marketplace-bot: Reminder: partner submission cutoff for next packaging window is 2026-04-12 23:59 UTC.
Maya: Timeline: PRs by Thu 5pm, internal review Fri afternoon, submit Mon. Who owns what?
Alex: I'll own packaging artifacts and submission checklist.
Sarah: Partner-facing quickstart + onboarding guide.
Devon: Infra examples + smoke harness.
Oliver: Cost + autoscale recommendations.
Maya: Final notes: add a short TF module usage snippet (module source + inputs only). Example inputs to include: `refkit_vpc_id`, `kms_key_arn`, `region`. Publish internal review link by Friday if no blockers. Thanks :sparkles:
